title: Dualtron Popular
body_html:
The Dualtron Popular is a brand new electric scooter designed by Minimotors with the everyday driver in mind. What makes it Popular? It has commuter-friendly features, it’s super low maintenance, and built with excellent quality components—and is about to be the most sought-after adult electric scooter of 2023. This is a Dualtron scooter that hits 40 mph, but doesn’t come with a premium price tag. With an IPX7 waterproof rating, the Popular is constructed to withstand poor weather conditions and unforgiving roads. The air-filled tires, spring suspension, and drum brakes make for a very smooth ride. Because the suspension and brakes are enclosed, you’ll be less likely to accidentally damage them. Unlike other commuter scooters, the Popular has front and rear motors, resulting in powerful performance on flat ground and uphill. The EY2 display is a new full-color design that pairs with the Dualtron mobile app, so you can conveniently adjust the scooter’s settings from your smartphone. If you plan to ride a scooter to work or are looking for an excellent joy rider, the Dualtron Popular has a range of 25 miles on a single charge. That’s more than enough mileage for most round-trips. Don’t wait until all the cool kids have it; set the trend and get Popular today. 

  • Has folding handlebars, new centered EY2 display, finger throttle, rubber handlebar grips, and a button console for the lights and horn
  • Equipped with wide 9” tubeless pneumatic tires and dual drum brakes for excellent traction and safety 
  • Dual 450W motors, double wishbone front suspension, and spring rear suspension deliver a quick, comfortable ride
  • Deck is covered in non-slip grip tape with a rear footrest for extra standing room, with front and rear fenders to keep debris at bay
  • Includes built-in headlights, front turn signals, rear turn signals, and brake light, and programmable LED light bar in stem
  • Dualtron Popular electric scooter user manual coming soon

title: Dualtron Thunder 3
body_html:
The Dualtron Thunder 3 is the next generation of the Thunder electric scooter from Minimotors—and it’s packing every update and feature you need in a high-performance vehicle. Redesigned for rougher riding and higher efficiency, including an official IP rating, this Dualtron scooter is ridiculously fast and fun to ride. The Thunder 3 has a top speed of 62 mph. Like the Storm Limited, when you double-tap the throttle you unleash a 30A boost of power (known as the Overtake function). With 2880 Wh of battery capacity, you can travel up to 78 miles on a single charge. If you take long rides, the new LCD is large and centered, making it easier to read in any light. Also, the bright lights all over this expert electric scooter allow you to see where you’re going, and help other drivers see you coming. Another important safety feature is the improved braking system. The quad-piston hydraulic brakes on the Thunder 3 have 160 mm ventilated rotors designed to stay cool and stop firm. Combined with ultrawide 11” pre-sealed tubeless tires and a new patent-pending suspension system, the Thunder 3 feels amazing, rides fast, and won’t let you down when you’re ready to hit the road.  

  • Powered by dual 2500W motors, 50A controllers, and a 72V 40Ah LG battery 
  • Equipped with an adjustable steering stabilizer, water-resistant EY4 display, finger throttle, backlit button console, and folding handlebars
  • Has three charging ports, two ports for dual charging and one port for fast charging
  • Recharges in 26 hours with single standard charger or in 8 hours using single fast charger if battery is empty (fast charger sold separately) DUALTRON
  • Lighting package includes dual headlights, front and rear turn signals (deck), separate front and rear running lights (deck), brake lights (deck), taillight (kickplate), and programmable LEDs in the stem, swingarms, neck, and deck

Everyone remembers the legendary electric scooter, Dualtron Ultra, Minimotor’s first off-road type electric scooter; a monster capable of climbing slopes of 60-70% at incredible speeds. Your best ally for mountains and forest trips.

Our teams worked hard on a new version of the Ultra, Ultra 2, to bring back the off-road champion to the field with even higher performance, higher stability, new features, and many improvements.

title: DUALTRON STORM LTD ELECTRIC SCOOTER
body_html:
The Dualtron Storm Limited Electric Scooter is the new flagship powerhouse from MiniMotors. The Storm Limited features the highest voltage of any Dualtron scooter to date, with an enormous 84 Volt, 45 Ah LG battery pack. This equates to up to a whopping 135 miles of range! Power of up to 11,500 watts from the BLDC motors gives insane acceleration and top speed. The Storm Limited comes stock with all the bells and whistles, including a 95.4 Volt fast charger with GX20 charge ports, steering damper, fingerprint reader, and new RSC run flat tires. MiniMotors continues to raise the bar of electric scooter technology with the Storm Limited!

SPECS

  • Motor: MAX 11,500 watt BLDC dual hub motor
  • Battery: 84 volt - 45 Ah - 3,780Wh - LG M50T cells
  • Charge time: 11+ hours with the quick charger, 5.6+ hours with two fast chargers
  • Max mileage: 135 miles (mileage may vary depending on rider weight, road conditions, and ambient temperature)
  • Max Speed: Up to 55+ mph (depending on rider weight, road conditions, state of charge, and ambient temperature)
  • Climbing Grade: 76% or 37 degrees depending on rider weight and state of charge
  • Braking System: Nutt Hydraulic brakes with ABS standard and 160mm disks
  • Lighting: Stem lighting, Dual LED Headlight and Taillight, Brake Light, Turn Signals
  • Built in Horn
  • Max Load: 330 lbs
  • Scooter Weight: 111 lbs
  • Product Material: Frame and Handle are aviation grade 6082-T6 aluminum alloy, the shaft is SCM440 steel, and plastic covers

title: Dualtron X Limited Electric Scooter
body_html:
The BEAST is BACK!  The baddest electric scooter on the planet just got a little bit badder.  The Dualtron X Limited continues to push the boundaries of what electric technology is capable of.  This is the new powerhouse of our lineup and the best electric scooter on the market.  Featuring the new EY4 color LCD display with Extreme OVERTAKE function for a boost of extra power when you need it, new motor magnet technology to optimize the power curve, 4 piston braking calipers, and a fully adjustable coil over suspension, the X Limited has it all and more.  Download the new MiniMotors App to get vital information on your ride and to connect with other riders in your area!

Seat kit will be sold separately.

  • Motor: 2,000 watt rated power BLDC dual hub motor
  • Battery: 84 volt - 60 Ah - 5,040Wh - LG main pack with a 12 volt - 16 Ah - 192Wh stem battery for lighting and accessories
  • Max mileage: 170 KM IN ECO( may vary depending on rider weight, road conditions, and ambient temperature)
  • Max Speed: Up to 110 KM/H (depending on rider weight, road conditions, state of charge, and ambient temperature)
  • Braking System: 4 Piston Hydraulic brakes with ABS standard and 160mm disks
  • Scooter Weight: 183 lbs
  • Product Material: Frame and Handle are aviation grade 6082-T6 aluminum alloy, the shaft is SCM440 steel, and plastic covers

COMPARE WITH  DUALTRON X 2

  • Controller Temperature Display
  • Password Setup
  • Auto Safe Mode
  • Bluetooth

  • Prevent BMS Cut Mode (ON/OFF)
  • Overtake Function (ON/OFF)
  • Built-In Anti-Theft (ON/OFF)

New Lighting Features :

  • New Rear Light Design ( Combined Brake and Indicator )
  • New Front Auxiliary Lights ( Combined Brake and Indicator )
  • New Rear Footrest Indicator
  • New RGB Lights ( Steering, Deck Sides, Inside Wheels )
  • New X Logo Illuminated on the Steering Tube
  • New Accelerator Ambient Light

New Motor Magnets :

  • New Longer Magnets 80 MM Long for Increased Power and Speed
  • New Magnet Material for Increased Power and Speed

New Suspension Springs : 25% Stronger 

  • Dualtron X2 - Uses 750 lbs/in. Spring
  • Dualtron X Limited - Uses 950 lbs/in. Spring = 25% Increase in Strength and Damping Effect.

Redesigned Suspension Arm Assembly:

  • Arm Movable Joint

  • Increased Stopping Power by 50% vs. DT X2 and DT X2-UP
  • 4-Piston Caliper Prevents Wobbling Motion of Disc Brake Rotor

More Upgrades :

title: Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus + Electric Scooter (60V, 35Ah LG)
body_html:
Exciting Upgrades To The Victor Luxury.

  • Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus is a resized Victor Luxury offering more space on the deck for the driver and suiting better our tallest customers.
  • The height of the e-scooter was raised by an additional 60mm and extended length of the deck by an additional 60mm.

Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus vs Victor Luxury

  • An even wider inflated 10 inches x 3.0 tires (80 / 65 – 6).
  • ECO/TURBO and SINGLE/DUAL multiswitch in order to give the rider maximum flexibility in the choice of the driving mode.
  • Bright headlight
  • Electric horn.
  • Turning signals.
  • Reflective stickers on the front bridge.

Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus, Performance

The Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus is, to date, one of our most powerful city-oriented electric scooters and one of the best ratio performance/quality/price currently on the market .

The Victor Luxury Plus is equipped with two motors on the front and the rear capable of delivering 2150W of max output power each, for a total of 4300W. Enough to climb any stiff hill you may encounter.

The two high-performance motors of the Victor Luxury Plus are powered by either a CN 60V28Ah (LITE) or an LG 60V35Ah (PRO) battery.  The PRO battery is composed of LG 21700 cells, amongst the best and highest quality cells on the market.

With normal driving conditions (medium speed, 65 kg user, warm temperatures), we expect the Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus to be able to achieve a range of 95km in its LITE version and 120km in its PRO version.

title: Dualtron City - swappable battery
body_html:
When it comes to tires, bigger is better with the new Dualtron City Electric Scooter! The Dualtron City features 15-inch tires capable of absorbing impact easier than the traditional 8-11 inch scooter tires. In addition to the larger tires, the City features a swappable battery pack to maximize range and minimize weight. The City comes stock with full hydraulic brakes providing more than ample stopping power. Performance still packs a punch with 4,000 watts of power on a mid-size frame. The power of Dualtron, refined, check out the new Dualtron City!

title: Dualtron Achilleus Electric Scooter - 60V 35Ah
body_html:
The Dualtron Achilleus electric scooter is the first compact 11 inch tire scooter from MiniMotors.  Featuring a massive 120 KM range from a 60 volt, 35 Ah battery, full hydraulic brakes, and awesome new lighting effects including a rear LED integrated kicktail, the Dualtron Achilleus is not to be missed.  This scooter is spec'd similar to the original Thunder with a thinner profile deck making it easier to fit in compact spaces you aren't riding this streamlined monster.  The excitement for electric scooters continues with the Dualtron Achilleus!
